vetSays.line: 🛡️ Gladys, the man in his 60s, Leo and Nina met them at the door — 4 put down. Gladys, the man in his 60s, Leo, Nina are hurt.
🛡️ Pablo, Gladys and Zakhariy met them at the door — 3 put down. Pablo, Gladys, Zakhariy are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Gladys, Greta and Rafael met them at the door — 3 put down. Gladys, Greta, Rafael are hurt.
🛡️ Gladys, Greta and Yara met them at the door — 1 put down, 2 barely walked away. Gladys, Greta, Yara are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Dmitri just put down Big-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Dmitri met them at the door — 1 put down. Dmitri is hurt.

regDeaths.name: a soft green glow under the water
the thing with headlights for eyes, standing too still
a raccoon with too many fingers, working at something
a dog-shaped silence at the treeline
two knobs on glass-still water, watching
